package.description: A free powerful, lightweight, full-featured screen capture tool for Windows platform.

en-US.description: A free powerful, lightweight, full-featured screen capture tool for Windows platform.
en-US.longDescription: PC Screen Capture is one free powerful, lightweight, full-featured screen capture tool for Windows platform. It allows you to take screenshots from any part of your screen in four ways, capture full desktop, active window, selected area and selected object, and you can also save images in BMP, JPG, GIF, PNG formats.
en-US.name: PC Screen Capture
